settings.purpose: Machine-readable comparison and visual gate settings for fidelity runs. Agents must copy these into loop.json / manifest and must not invent looser numbers after seeing results.

notes: Pixels with Euclidean RGB distance above inspectionThreshold are counted as beyond.
This alone is not a complete PASS rule for the declared profile.

visualCertification.authority: Operator delegated gate definition in chat on 2026-10-08; these rules are frozen before new implementation attempts. Approval is of the policy, not existing output.

aggregate.weighting: Arithmetic mean of equally weighted scheduled full-window frames; extra boundary/subframe samples must pass per-frame rules but do not change the window mean.

localRegions.definition: For each tile on both grids, hot pixels / max(64, pixels whose reference OR native RGB differs from the declared background by more than 24). Count all hot pixels, including unexpected background content.

reject: Missing or extra subject/detail, stroke/fill, clipping or mask contribution
Wrong paint, geometry, stacking or scope semantics
Visible pose displacement, timing/visibility error or animated flicker
materialReview.reviewCoverage: Review every automatic failure and start, end, key boundaries, segment midpoints, worst frames and a full-window contact sheet/sequence for each fixture and both native routes. Unreviewed fixtures remain VISUAL_UNVERIFIED.

alpha.rule: Both reference and native PNGs must be opaque after compositing onto the declared background. No standalone transparent-alpha fidelity is claimed; such a profile needs separate rules.

coverage.missingCapture: NOT_RUN or BLOCKED, never zero error or PASS

referenceControls.environment: Matched viewport, fit, DPR 1, explicitly pinned subframe mode and fonts/assets/effect profile. Incomplete readiness or unreliable control quarantines comparison.

visualCertification.passRule: All conversion, round-trip, full-window aggregate/local/alpha, reference-control, material-review and regression/resource gates must pass. No implicit PASS from capture execution labels.

reference.browser: Resolve via evaluation/harness/chrome.ts (GVR_CHROME / CHROME_PATH, then platform defaults). Record the resolved binary and --version in environment.json.
